name: 27689-mtpdecode-glm47flash-tp4
model: zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash. Public, ungated, MIT; 62.4 GB of bf16 safetensors in 48 shards. NOT CACHED here, so it downloads once before the first run.
parallelism: tp4, plain tensor parallel. num_attention_heads is 20, so tp_size must divide 20 and four is the largest legal value inside one node. ~15.6 GB of weights per card.
architecture: Glm4MoeLiteForCausalLM, 30B-A3B Mixture-of-Experts in bf16, multi-head latent attention over 20 heads, with a multi-token-prediction layer in the same checkpoint. The rest is readable off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 256 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, exactly 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 output tokens out with no variance, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`. Prompts are drawn independently and share no prefix.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant for eight concurrent writers, generating 1024-token answers from 1024-token prompts on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Engine version and commit are in configs/setupcard.md.

model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash

# num_attention_heads is 20, so tp-size must divide 20; TP8 is impossible for this checkpoint.
tp-size: 4

# Explicit: left unset, this engine auto-selects fa3 for an MLA architecture on Hopper.
attention-backend: flashinfer

# The draft is the checkpoint's own multi-token-prediction layer; the engine resolves it from
# model-path for this architecture, so no speculative-draft-model-path is set.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 3

max-running-requests: 8
cuda-graph-max-bs: 8
disable-radix-cache: true
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
